extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance figures digitised: Figure 1 (temperature dependence) and Figure 2 (time-on-stream stability). Figures 3–8 are characterization/TPD/TPR/XRD/XPS and were skipped. CH3OH yield is plotted in Figure 1d and Figure 2, but the response schema has no methanol-yield field; these plotted yield values are therefore recorded in notes. All plotted performance values are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'. Catalyst legend in Figure 1 uses labels without the second 's' in CNT in the image, but records use the user-provided catalyst names CZ/CNTs-1, CZ/CNTs-2 and CZ/CNTs-3.
